name: Forced displacement
value: Moyale tens of thousands; no 500k event
summary: Tens of thousands fled Ethiopian clashes into Kenya; 64,000 Nigerians reached Niger in 2026; no new 500,000 event found
state: Tens of thousands have fled clashes in Ethiopia's Moyale area into Kenya since late October (AllAfrica, 11 Nov; UN News). UNHCR said on 10 Nov that about 64,000 people have fled northern Nigeria to Niger since the start of 2026 (UN News). Both are well below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line, and searches on 11 Nov found no single new event of that scale; Sudan's displacement crisis is long-running rather than new.
for_you: New arrivals in Kenya and Niger depend on UNHCR and IOM for shelter, food and water. Large new displacement tends to follow escalation in active conflicts.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month (Watch line)

sources.title: AllAfrica — Tens of thousands flee into Kenya as clashes erupt in Ethiopia's Moyale

why: Over 120 million people are forcibly displaced; new mass displacement drives regional instability and migration politics.
